subject: general
question: 47 people are standing in a row facing north. Suhana is 24th from the right end, while Bimla is 37th from the left end. How many people are there between Suhana and Bimla?
solution:
Suhana is 24th from the right 

 
• Her position from the left:
 
• 47-24+1=24
 
• So Suhana is 24th from the left.
 
• • Bimla is 37th from the left.

Number of people between them:

(37 - 24 ) - 1

= 13 - 1

=12

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
